content.text: There are trips you don't need to travel far, just go where you want to be.
The first of the year's Dao is the cold enough to wear a thin coat, which is the occasional smell in the early winds, which are slow afternoons alongside the hot coffee cup.
Three days and two nights in the mountain streets not rushing, not interrupting, enough to change the wind – changing the pace of life – refrigerating energy for a full new year.
The journey is well-designed, easy-going, suitable for the family wanting a light break, the group you want to find a relaxed space, or anyone who wants to start a new year with a safe trip.
